scope: M1 Ra is the Ra fabric authority: it unifies independently operated Horus instances into one durable work fabric and owns router behavior. Horus is the local Pantheon system instance on the Mac in front of the operator; each Horus retains local system authority but does not supersede M1 Ra for routing or shared-fabric decisions. Mercury is the authenticated information-interconnect protocol between Horus instances. Photon is the hardware transfer device, not a Horus alias or a control-plane owner. Apollo is the inference engine used by local LLM workloads; Apollo Flash is its speculative execution profile. Ma'at evaluates evidence, decisions, quality, and resource contention across the fabric.
